[NEXT]

To prevent this, install a surge protector with USB and Ethernet ports and configure the thermostat to enter a low-power mode during peak storm hours. You should also set up a secondary backup device, like a battery-powered smart plug, to maintain temperature control if the primary system fails. For rare cases where the device loses sync, perform a factory reset and re-sync it with your home network after the storm has passed.  

[END]

[NEXT]  
During a power outage, the thermostat may lose connectivity and fail to sync with the home network, so I recommend installing a backup battery-powered module for uninterrupted operation.
